desc: SRM Contractors Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 05/09/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve the proposal to raise funds by issue of equity shares or convertible instruments through public and/or private offerings including preferential issue, qualified institutions placement, further public offer or other permissible mode and consider and approve the Draft Director report of the Company for the financial year 2025-26
